subject: Setting data and initial values of latent nodes

messages.author: bfa4a88c8a5bc54e
messages.subject: Setting data and initial values of latent nodes
parts:
Hi all,

A few months ago I wrote a Jolly-Seber model where some of the ecological states were provided as known data and the unknowns were provided with (valid) initial values. I tried to run that code today and I was getting dynamic index out of bounds errors, and after building the model looking at the ecological states doesn't provide the expected values.

Here, I show the top 10 rows of the known states and the remaining initial values matrices:

> head(m1data$z, 10) ; head(m1inits()$z, 10)
      [,1] [,2] [,3]
 [1,]    3   NA   NA
 [2,]    3   NA   NA
 [3,]    3    3   NA
 [4,]    3   NA   NA
 [5,]    3   NA   NA
 [6,]    3   NA   NA
 [7,]    3   NA   NA
 [8,]    3   NA   NA
 [9,]    3   NA   NA
[10,]    3   NA   NA
      [,1] [,2] [,3]
 [1,]   NA    4    4
 [2,]   NA    4    4
 [3,]   NA   NA    4
 [4,]   NA    4    4
 [5,]   NA    4    4
 [6,]   NA    4    4
 [7,]   NA    4    4
 [8,]   NA    4    4
 [9,]   NA    4    4
[10,]   NA    4    4

After building the model and look at the top 10 rows of the ecological state, I get this:

> head(Rm1model$z, 10)
      [,1] [,2] [,3]
 [1,]   NA    4    4
 [2,]   NA    4    4
 [3,]   NA    3    4
 [4,]   NA    4    4
 [5,]   NA    4    4
 [6,]   NA    4    4
 [7,]   NA    4    4
 [8,]   NA    4    4
 [9,]   NA    4    4
[10,]   NA    4    4

Is it possible something changed in nimble since 0.13 or should I keep looking for errors in my code that I just don't remember having?

Cheers,

Matt
